in_sanskrit.name: काश्यप
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Kashyap is derived from the Sanskrit word 'kashyapa', which means 'seer', 'sage', or 'wise'. This name is often associated with the sage Kashyapa, who is a central figure in Hindu mythology and is known as the father of various gods and demigods.

in_hindi.name: काश्यप
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Kashyap in Hindi is often translated as 'kevalpati', which means 'master of one's own consciousness'. This name is revered in Hinduism and is given to boys who are believed to have great wisdom and the ability to master their own thoughts and emotions.

in_tamil.name: காச்சியப்
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name Kashyap is translated as 'kopam perumāṉ', which means 'great lord of desire'. This name is believed to bring good fortune and success in life.

in_telugu.name: కాశ్యప్
in_telugu.long_meaning: In Telugu, the name Kashyap is translated as 'jeypudu', which means 'one who has conquered'. This name is given to boys who are believed to have strong willpower and the ability to overcome challenges.

in_marathi.name: Kashyap
